class_name: 対象-関連-ヲメグッテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Names a matter people are contending over: the following predicate is usually one of dispute or divided opinion (争う, 対立する, 意見が割れる), though it also covers talk swirling around a matter with no clear sides (憶測が流れる). について and に関して are neutral about the subject matter, while をめぐって frames it as contested, and it belongs mainly to news-report and written registers. The prenominal をめぐる is at least as common as the て-form.

examples.ruby: 遺産[いさん]の相続[そうぞく]をめぐって、親族[しんぞく]が長年[ながねん]争[あらそ]っている。
examples.english: The relatives have been fighting over the inheritance for years.

examples.ruby: 新[あたら]しい球場[きゅうじょう]の建設[けんせつ]をめぐって、市民[しみん]の意見[いけん]が割[わ]れた。
examples.english: Residents were split over the construction of the new ballpark.

examples.ruby: 監督[かんとく]の交代[こうたい]をめぐる報道[ほうどう]が連日[れんじつ]続[つづ]いている。
examples.english: Coverage of the manager's replacement has run day after day.
